title: Pointed etale algebras are essentially small
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring and K a chosen separable closure of its residue field. The full subcategory of Over(CommAlgCat.of R K) consisting of etale R-algebras is essentially small.

proof.text: An etale R-algebra is finitely presented, hence finitely generated (Mathlib Algebra.Etale.finitePresentation and Algebra.FiniteType.of_finitePresentation). Map a pointed etale algebra to the same algebra and pointing in CostructuredArrow Q.ι (CommAlgCat.of R K), where Q is the finite-type object property. On morphisms retain the underlying algebra map. The commuting triangle is exactly Over.w. The inverse map on each hom set is ObjectProperty.homMk composed with Over.homMk, using CostructuredArrow.w; the two composites are identities. Thus the functor is fully faithful. Mathlib instEssentiallySmallFGAlgCat proves essential smallness of Q.FullSubcategory, and CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.essentiallySmall proves essential smallness of the codomain since CommAlgCat R is locally small. Apply CategoryTheory.essentiallySmall_of_fully_faithful.

theorem pointedEtale_essentiallySmall
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [Algebra R K]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] :
    let P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of R K)) := fun X ↦ Etale R X.left
    EssentiallySmall.{u} P.FullSubcategory
